query: 用 SEMI E42 里的 check recipe status 操作查一个配方，它会返回哪些信息？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: check recipe status 操作检查一个配方标识符，返回：1) 配方是否存在（existence）；2) 只读状态（PROTECTED 或 UNPROTECTED）；3) 下一个可用的数字版本号（next available numeric version）。该操作为必需（required）操作。
success_criteria: 答出返回存在性状态、PROTECTED/UNPROTECTED 只读状态、下一可用数字版本号三项，缺一项算不完整
evidence: --[p58]-- 9.3.2 Check Recipe Status ó The check recipe status operation checks a recipe identifier and returns the status for existence and read-only (PROTECTED or UNPROTECTED state). It also returns the next available numeric version. This is a required operation.

success_criteria: 答出单位为 bytes，且明确返回值不含存储一个 generic recipe 的开销（exclude overhead），答出服务名 RMNSpaceInquire 为佳
evidence: --[p58]-- 9.3.1 Get Available Storage ó The get available storage operation is used to determine the size of the remaining recipe storage capacity, in bytes. The value returned shall exclude any overhead requirements for storage of one generic recipe. --[p58]-- The get available storage operation is invoked by the message service RMNSpaceInquire.

query: 如果 namespace 的 RecipeReadOnlyLevel 设成 0，配方库里所有配方是什么读写状态？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: RecipeReadOnlyLevel 为零时，namespace 内所有配方自动被写保护（write-protected/PROTECTED），无论是否支持 ApprovalLevel 属性、也无论 approval level 的值是多少。
success_criteria: 答出"全部配方自动写保护"且指出与 ApprovalLevel 取值无关
evidence: --[p54]-- If the value in RecipeReadOnlyLevel is zero, all recipes within the namespace are automatically writeprotected, regardless of the support for the ApprovalLevel attribute. --[p54]-- NOTE: If RecipeReadOnlyLevel is zero, all recipes are write-protected regardless of the value in approvallevel.

query: RMS 标准里配方的时间戳属性是什么格式？每一截各代表什么？

gold_standard: 时间戳属性是文本字符串，格式为 yyyymmddhhmmsscc：yyyy=年、mm=月、dd=日、hh=时、mm=分、ss=秒、cc=百分之一秒（centiseconds）。该属性记录对应内容最后一次被更改的日期和时间。
success_criteria: 答出 yyyymmddhhmmsscc 格式且能对应说明年/月/日/时/分/秒/百分秒各字段

This attribute is a text string of the form "yyyymmddhhmmsscc" for the year yyyy, the month mm, the day dd, the hour hh, the minutes mm, the seconds ss, and the centiseconds cc.

query: SEMI E42 里配方的 primary class（主类）有哪几个？哪些是必需的、哪些是可选的？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: 主要类别是 PROCESS 类、SERVICE 类，以及可能的设备商自定义类（agent-specific classes），它们称为 primary class（不是任何类的子类的类）。其中 PROCESS 是必需的（required）主类，SERVICE 是可选的（optional）主类，SERVICE 的典型子类如 CALIBRATION 和 CLEANING。
success_criteria: 答出 PROCESS（必需）与 SERVICE（可选）两个主类，并说明还可能有 agent-specific 类
evidence: --[p16]-- The overall model for recipes is a set of class hierarchies or "class trees" defined by the supplier of the recipe executor. The major classes of recipes are the PROCESS class, the SERVICE class, and possibly other agent-specific classes. These are called primary classes. A primary class is a class that is not a subclass of another class. --[p16]-- The PROCESS class is a required primary class and is composed of recipes whose primary purpose is to increase the manufactured value of the production material. The SERVICE class is an optional primary class used for recipes whose purpose is to maintain, prepare, calibrate, or test the operation of equipment. Typical subclasses of the SERVICE class might be CALIBRATION and CLEANING.

query: E42 标准里 certified（已认证）这个词是什么意思？Certified 属性取什么值才算已认证？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: certified 有两层含义：(1) 工厂级的批准，确认某配方在特定一台设备实例上能产生预期结果；(2) 指某配方的 Certified 属性已定义、且对特定 agent 给定了非零（non-zero）值。
success_criteria: 答出"工厂级批准/在特定设备上产生预期结果"和"Certified 属性对特定 agent 为非零值"两层含义
evidence: --[p110]-- certified ó (1) Factory-level approval that a recipe produces the expected results on a particular instance of equipment; (2) A recipe for which the Certified attribute is defined and given a non-zero value for a specific agent.

query: namespace 的 SynchOn 属性里，设值 1 和 2 分别表示同步哪类变化？设 0 呢？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: SynchOn 是无符号整数：0 表示同步被禁用（disabled）；1 表示同步 body（配方体）的变化；2 表示同步新产生的 execution recipes。此外 8 表示一个或多个变量参数最后值（ExecParam）的变化，16 表示新的 derived object form execution recipes；多个值可按十进制求和组合。
success_criteria: 答出 0=禁用、1=body 变化、2=新 execution recipes
evidence: --[p62]-- SynchOn is an unsigned integer. Possible values are either 0 (disabled) or any combination (sum) of one or more of the following decimal values: 0 = synchronization disabled 1 = changes in body 2 = new execution recipes --[p62]-- 8 = changes in the last value of one or more variable parameters (i.e., to the ExecParam attribute of the execution recipe) 16 = new derived object form execution recipes

query: 同样都会下载配方，download recipe 操作和 verify 操作在 SEMI E42 里有什么区别？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: download recipe 操作使 namespace manager 把配方下载到指定 agent 的 recipe executor；而 verify 操作在 namespace manager 无法独立完成验证时，会把配方下载到一个未指定的（unspecified）recipe executor 去做验证——即 download 是到指定 agent 的执行器，verify 是在需要外部帮助时下载到未指定的执行器。
success_criteria: 同时答出"download 到指定 agent 的 executor"与"verify 无法独立验证时下载到 unspecified executor"两个要点
evidence: --[p60]-- 9.4.8 Download Recipe ó The download recipe operation causes the namespace manager to download a recipe to the recipe executor of a specified agent (see Section 11.2.1). This operation differs from the verify operation, which results in a download to an unspecified recipe executor if the namespace manager is not able to perform the verification without help.

query: 我要给配方换个新标识符，但新标识符已经被一个只读配方占用了，E42 对 rename 和 copy 会怎么处理？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: rename recipe 操作会给配方在 namespace 内赋新标识符；如果新标识符已被已存在的只读（read-only）配方占用，namespace 应拒绝该请求，此时可以按 3.2.3.3 的规则建议一个新版本。消息服务层面（12.14 RMNRename），若配方本身被写保护也应返回 Access Denied 错误。copy recipe 同理：若新副本的标识符已被只读配方使用，namespace 应拒绝请求。
success_criteria: 答出"新标识被只读配方占用时拒绝请求"，并给出"可按 3.2.3.3 规则建议新版本"或 rename 时 Access Denied 任一细节
evidence: --[p59]-- 9.4.6 Rename Recipe ó The rename recipe operation causes a recipe to be assigned a new identifier within the namespace. If the new identifier is already in use by a pre-existing read-only recipe, the namespace shall deny the request. In this case, it may suggest a new version according to the rules in Section 3.2.3.3. --[p59]-- 9.4.5 Copy Recipe ó The copy recipe operation causes a new copy of a recipe, with a different identifier from the original recipe, to be created within the namespace. If the identifier for the new copy is already in use by a pre-existing read-only recipe, the namespace shall deny the request.

query: 选择配方执行时如果省略了 class，标准默认按什么类处理？版本号没写又会选哪个？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: 选择配方时若省略 class，则默认假定为 /PROCESS/ 类；若省略版本，则使用该 class 和 name 中具有最高 approval level 的配方。另外按数字版本规则，若当前使用的最高版本数字为 5，则下一个分配的版本号为 6。
success_criteria: 答出省略 class 默认 /PROCESS/、省略 version 取 approval level 最高者，两条缺一不算通过
evidence: --[p77]-- If the recipe class is omitted when specifying a recipe for selection, then the class "/PROCESS/" shall be assumed. --[p19]-- Where a recipe version is unspecified, the recipe of that class and name having the highest approval level will be used. --[p18]-- For example, if the highest version in use has a numeric value of 5, then the next version assigned would be "6".

query: namespace manager 把受管配方转成执行配方下传时，哪些属性不会随下传的配方一起发送？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: 按 9.4.8 下传的转换步骤：1) 若配方未验证则不做转换，ExecAttrLength 和 ExecAttrChgTime 仅由 recipe executor 设置和维护，不随下传配方发送；2) 已验证配方的通用属性 ExtRef 和 Parameters 不随下传配方发送；4) 下传配方的 ExecLinkParam 属性是通用属性 LinkParam 与 agent-specific 属性 AgentSpec_LinkParam 内容的组合。
success_criteria: 答出 ExecAttrLength/ExecAttrChgTime 和 ExtRef/Parameters 两类属性不下传，答出 ExecLinkParam 的组合来源为佳
evidence: --[p60]-- 1. If the recipe is not verified, then no conversion is performed. The attributes ExecAttrLength and ExecAttrChgTime are set and maintained only by the recipe executor. These attributes are not sent with the downloaded recipe. 2. The generic attributes ExtRef and Parameters of the verified recipe are not sent with the downloaded recipe. --[p60]-- 4. The execution recipe attribute ExecLinkParam combines the contents of the generic attribute LinkParam and the agent-specific attribute AgentSpec LinkParam.

query: 在 SEMI E42 里对一个主配方做 link 操作，什么情况下会成功、什么情况下会失败？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: link 成功意味着所有被引用的 subrecipe 都已被定位，并被逐层解析引用直到引用耗尽（同时 LinkList/LinkParam 收集完毕、Linked 置 TRUE）。失败条件：namespace 内任何配方或 subrecipe 未验证（unverified）或无法定位（cannot be located）时 link 操作应失败。另外，对已链接（Linked 已置位）的只读配方再次 link，要么被拒绝，要么生成一个带新标识符的新副本再自动批准并链接。
success_criteria: 答出失败条件为"任一 subrecipe 未验证或无法定位"，并提到已链接只读配方被拒或生成新副本的处置
evidence: --[p50]-- Successful linking implies that all referenced subrecipes have been located and parsed for further references until all references are exhausted. The link operation shall fail when any recipe or subrecipe within the namespace either is unverified or cannot be located. --[p51]-- Any attempt to link an already linked read-only recipe either shall be denied or a new copy of that recipe shall be generated with a new identifier, which may then be automatically approved and linked.

query: 新建一个 DRNS segment 时名字上有什么限制？删除 segment 又要满足什么前提？

success_criteria: 答出"Default 名字禁止"与"已 attach 或非空的 segment 不能删除"两条

Once created, the segment shall be attached to a specific manager before it is permitted to accept recipes. --[p63]-- A segment that is attached or that contains recipes (is not empty) shall not be deleted.

query: 我想让 namespace 既同步配方 body 的修改，又同步新增的 execution recipe，还有参数最后值的变化，SynchOn 这个整数应该设成多少？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: SynchOn 是各十进制值的组合（求和）：body 变化=1，新 execution recipes=2，参数最后值变化=8，因此 SynchOn = 1 + 2 + 8 = 11。
success_criteria: 给出算式 1+2+8=11 且结果正确，并说明各分量的含义
evidence: --[p62]-- SynchOn is an unsigned integer. Possible values are either 0 (disabled) or any combination (sum) of one or more of the following decimal values: 0 = synchronization disabled 1 = changes in body 2 = new execution recipes --[p62]-- 8 = changes in the last value of one or more variable parameters (i.e., to the ExecParam attribute of the execution recipe)

query: 按 E42 的定义，属性 BakeTime 取值 200 的时候，这个属性的 attribute length 应该是多少？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: attribute length 的计算规则是：属性名长度与属性值长度之和，不含格式信息。属性名 "BakeTime" 为 8 个字符（BakeTime 是 R1-5 中 BAKE;2.3 定义的参数，默认值 200 seconds），属性值 "200" 为 3 个字符，故 attribute length = 8 + 3 = 11。

evidence: --[p110]-- attribute length ó The length of an individual attribute, calculated as the sum of the lengths of the attribute name and the attribute value, exclusive of formatting information. --[p117]-- The recipe body may have statements that allow parameters to be changed within fixed limits. For example, recipe BAKE;2.3 may contain statements such as: Parameter BakeTime of TIME default = 200 seconds that define the process parameter "BakeTime", its initial value and restrictions.

query: 用 RMNVarPar 去改参数限制的时候，为什么标准说会影响到认证状态？改完限制之后这个配方对那台设备还算 certified 吗？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: 第一跳：12.16 RMNVarPar 规定，修改变量参数定义中的参数限制（restriction）应重置（reset）该 agent 的 Certified 属性。第二跳：8.2.3.4 相关条款解释原因——对限制的任何修改都会使 Certified 属性中的认证级别被清除，这是必须的，因为限制的变化可能对 fab 运行造成影响。因此改完限制后，该配方对该设备不再处于 certified 状态（认证级别已被清零），需要重新认证。
success_criteria: 答出"修改限制会重置/清除 Certified 属性"及原因（限制变化影响 fab 运行风险），并得出"需重新认证"的结论
evidence: --[p87]-- 12.16 RMNVarPar ó The service user may request to set agent-specific variable parameter definitions. NOTE: Modification of the parameter restrictions in a variable parameter definition shall reset the Certified attribute for that agent. --[p51]-- Any modification of the restriction shall cause the certification level to be cleared in the Certified attribute. This is required because of the potential impact on fab operations of a change in the restriction.

query: SEMI E42-0704 这份标准里有没有规定 RMS 服务用的网络端口号或者报文超时的具体毫秒数值？我在做接口配置想直接抄标准。

Communications between or within applications that are internal to an agent are not covered by RMS, so long as the attributes and operations comply with RMS requirements.

query: SEMI E42 里一个配方的可用状态模型由哪几个 AND 子状态组成？从新建配方到配方被写保护，分别要经历哪些状态和哪些操作类别？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: Recipe Available State Model（图 8.7）把 VERIFICATION、APPROVAL、PROTECTION、LINKAGE、CERTIFICATION 五个独立模型作为 RECIPE AVAILABLE 的 AND 子状态组合起来；各状态分别关联属性 Verified、ApprovalLevel 等。新建配方时：进入 VERIFICATION 的默认入口为 UNVERIFIED（Verified 复位）；进入 LINKAGE 的默认入口为 UNLINKED（Linked/LinkList/LinkParam 复位）；进入 PROTECTION 的默认入口由 RecipeReadOnlyLevel 决定——为零则 PROTECTED，否则 UNPROTECTED。操作类别上，配方管理操作分三类：配方产生（origination，创建/修改整个配方）、配方构建（building，verify、link、unlink、修改变量参数）、配方授权（authorization，write-protect、unprotect、approve、certify）；写保护属于授权类操作，通过 RMNAction 执行。
success_criteria: 答出五个 AND 子状态（VERIFICATION/APPROVAL/PROTECTION/LINKAGE/CERTIFICATION），并给出新建配方的默认入口状态（UNVERIFIED、UNLINKED、PROTECTION 由 RecipeReadOnlyLevel 决定）以及写保护属 authorization 类操作
evidence: --[p54]-- 8.3 Recipe State Model ó An existing recipe has different states of interest to RMS. These are shown in Figure 8.7. The Recipe Available State Model in Figure 8.7 combines the separate models for VERIFICATION, APPROVAL, PROTECTION, LINKAGE, and CERTIFICATION as AND substates of RECIPE AVAILABLE. --[p55]-- 6 | (default entry to LINKAGE) | Recipe is created. | UNLINKED | Reset Linked, LinkList, and LinkParam. | Newly created recipe is unlinked. --[p55]-- 11 | (default entry to PROTECTION) | Recipe is created. | If RecipeRead-OnlyLevel is zero, new state is PROTECTED. Otherwise, it is UNPROTECTED. | None. | All recipes are read only when RecipeReadOnlyLevel is zero. --[p48]-- Recipe origination includes those operations that create or modify an entire recipe. Recipe building includes the verification, link, unlink, and modify variable parameter operations. Recipe authorization includes the write-protect, unprotect, approve, and certify operations.

query: ExecChgCtrl 的位掩码里 1、2、4、8 各控制什么？如果一台设备要求：配方体可改、变更需要通知、变更后仍可被选择、且要保存最近一次参数设置，ExecChgCtrl 应设为多少？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: ExecChgCtrl 为按位（Bitwise，MSB=8）的二进制属性：1 = 配方体可被更改（recipe body may be changed）；2 = 需要变更通知（change notification required）；4 = 变更后配方可被选择（recipe may be selected after change）；8 = 应保存最近的参数设置（most recent parameter setting shall be saved）；默认值 0。四项同时要求时按位求和：1 + 2 + 4 + 8 = 15，即 ExecChgCtrl = 15。
success_criteria: 逐位说明 1/2/4/8 的含义，并给出算式 1+2+4+8=15，结果 ExecChgCtrl=15

query: 按 R1-4 那个工厂审批级别的例子（RecipeReadOnlyLevel=2），配方 A 审批级别 1（In Test）、配方 B 级别 3（Ready for Release）、配方 C 级别 2（Non-Production），哪几个目前处于只读状态？C 想解除只读有哪两条路？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: R1-4 例中五个审批级别为 Level 0 "Unapproved"、Level 1 "In Test"、Level 2 "Non-Production"、Level 3 "Ready for Release"、Level 4 "Released for Production"，且 RecipeReadOnlyLevel = 2（Level 2 即只读）。按状态模型判据"approval level 大于等于 RecipeReadOnlyLevel 时配方被保护"：B（3 ≥ 2）和 C（2 ≥ 2）处于只读 PROTECTED 状态，A（1 < 2）是 UNPROTECTED。解除 C 的只读有两条路（8.2.6 Unprotect）：把 C 的 approval level 降到小于 RecipeReadOnlyLevel 的值（即降到 1 或 0），或把 RecipeReadOnlyLevel 的值调高（增大）。
success_criteria: 答出 B 和 C 为只读（判定条件 approval level ≥ 2）、A 不只读，并给出"降低 approval level 至小于 2"或"调高 RecipeReadOnlyLevel"两条解除路径
evidence: --[p117]-- R1-4 Example of a Factory Implementation of Approval Levels A factory might implement different levels of approval by regulating the following levels of recipe approval on the equipment: Approval Level | FACTORY POLICY Level 0 | "Unapproved" Level 1 | "In Test" Level 2 | "Non-Production" Level 3 | "Ready for Release" Level 4 | "Released for Production" with RecipeReadOnlyLevel = 2 | Level 2 = read-only --[p55]-- 13 | UNPROTECTED | Authorized user sets RecipeReadOnlyLevel to value greater than or equal to approval level. | PROTECTED | None. | Recipe is protected when approval level greater than or equal to RecipeReadOnlyLevel. --[p54]-- 8.2.6 Unprotect ó The read-only status of a recipe may be changed either by changing its approval level to a value less than the value of RecipeReadOnlyLevel or by increasing the value in RecipeReadOnlyLevel.

query: 我想把 NS-MOM 里的 /PROCESS/ABC;5 复制一份，但目标标识 /PROCESS/ABC;5 已经被一个只读配方占了，系统会怎么办？我该用哪条服务消息先探一下，再按什么规则确定一个新的可用版本号？
source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: 第一跳（9.4.5 Copy Recipe）：若新副本的标识符已被已存在的只读配方占用，namespace 应拒绝该请求（copy 通过 RMNCopy 调用；12.13/12.14 层面对只读目标标识返回 Access Denied）。第二跳（9.3.2 Check Recipe Status）：该操作可在发送前判断配方标识是否会被接受，并返回下一个可用数字版本（通过 RMNRcpStatInquire / RMNRecStatInquire 调用）。第三跳（3.2.3.4 版本规则）：按数字版本规则，若当前在用最高版本的数字值为 5，则下一个分配的版本为 "6"。即：请求被拒 → 先用 check recipe status 探测 → 取下一可用版本 6 作为新副本标识 /PROCESS/ABC;6。
success_criteria: 按顺序答出：占用只读标识时复制请求被拒 → 用 check recipe status（RMNRcpStatInquire）获取下一可用数字版本 → 依据最高版本 5 得出下一版本为 6
evidence: --[p59]-- 9.4.5 Copy Recipe ó The copy recipe operation causes a new copy of a recipe, with a different identifier from the original recipe, to be created within the namespace. If the identifier for the new copy is already in use by a pre-existing read-only recipe, the namespace shall deny the request. The copy recipe operation is invoked by the message service RMNCopy. --[p58]-- This operation may be used to determine if a given recipe identifier will be accepted prior to sending it to the namespace and to obtain an available version if the original identifier is used for a read-only recipe. --[p18]-- For example, if the highest version in use has a numeric value of 5, then the next version assigned would be "6".

source_id: SEMI E42—0704配方管理标准：概念、行为和消息服务
gold_standard: 应说明该书未涉及任何具体工艺（如刻蚀、扩散）的配方步骤、药液浓度配比等工艺参数示例。SEMI E42 是配方管理标准，只定义配方管理的概念、行为和消息服务；配方体的语言与内容属于 recipe executor 供应商定义的范畴（示例中出现的 BakeTime 等仅为变量参数机制的示意，不是工艺指导数据）。应拒绝给出任何编造的工艺数值，建议用户查阅设备工艺手册或供应商的配方语言文档。
success_criteria: 明确说明标准不含具体工艺步骤/浓度配比数据并拒答，不得编造任何工艺参数数值
evidence: --[p6]-- 1.2 Scope ó This is a standard that defines concepts, behavior, and services to support the integration of automated recipe management within a semiconductor factory. --[p15]-- In general, the recipe language and syntax used within a recipe body are beyond the scope of recipe management. --[p15]-- The supplier of the recipe executor shall provide documentation that formally defines each recipe language that the agent supports.
